claims: The March 2026 Consumer Price Index (CPI) report showed annual inflation of 3.3%.
The March 2026 Consumer Price Index (CPI) report showed monthly inflation of 0.9%.
Annual inflation of 3.3% and monthly inflation of 0.9% are the highest levels since May 2024.
Gasoline prices increased by 21.2% according to the March 2026 CPI report.
The 21.2% increase in gasoline prices represents the largest monthly increase since 1967.
Annual inflation was 3.3% for the 12 months ending in March 2026.
Annual inflation was up from 2.4% in February 2026.
Monthly inflation was 0.9% for March 2026 (seasonally adjusted).
Monthly inflation was up from 0.3% in February 2026.
Surging energy costs linked to the conflict with Iran were the primary driver of the March inflation spike.
The conflict with Iran tightened the global oil supply.
The Nasdaq was up 0.35% on Friday as investors reacted to the March 2026 CPI report.
The S&P 500 fell 0.11% on Friday as investors reacted to the March 2026 CPI report.
The next CPI report is scheduled for May 12, 2026.
